package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo/options"
)

func main() {
	uri := os.Getenv("MONGODB_URI")
	if uri == "" {
		uri = "mongodb://localhost:27017"
	}
	client, err := mongo.Connect(options.Client().ApplyURI(uri))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	defer client.Disconnect(ctx)
	collection := client.Database("shop").Collection("orders")

	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "id", Value: objectID("65f1c0de9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b")},
		{Key: "at", Value: bson.NewDateTimeFromTime(time.Date(2024, time.March, 1, 10, 20, 30, 123000000, time.UTC))},
		{Key: "long", Value: int64(9007199254740993)},
		{Key: "decimal", Value: decimal128("0.10")},
		{Key: "int", Value: 42},
		{Key: "double", Value: 2.5},
		{Key: "big", Value: 3000000000},
		{Key: "regex", Value: bson.Regex{Pattern: "^ma", Options: "i"}},
		{Key: "uuid", Value: bson.Binary{Subtype: 0x04, Data: []byte{0x3b, 0x24, 0x11, 0x01, 0xe2, 0xbb, 0x42, 0x55, 0x8c, 0xaf, 0x41, 0x36, 0xc5, 0x66, 0xa9, 0x62}}},
		{Key: "binary", Value: bson.Binary{Subtype: 0x00, Data: []byte{0x01, 0x02, 0x03}}},
		{Key: "timestamp", Value: bson.Timestamp{T: 1700000000, I: 1}},
		{Key: "min", Value: bson.MinKey{}},
		{Key: "max", Value: bson.MaxKey{}},
		{Key: "none", Value: nil},
		{Key: "yes", Value: true},
		{Key: "nan", Value: math.NaN()},
		{Key: "list", Value: bson.A{1, "a"}},
		{Key: "empty", Value: bson.D{}},
	}
	sort := bson.D{{Key: "at", Value: -1}}
	opts := options.Find().SetSort(sort)

	cursor, err := collection.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var results []bson.M
	if err := cursor.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, doc := range results {
		fmt.Println(doc)
	}
}

func decimal128(s string) bson.Decimal128 {
	d, err := bson.ParseDecimal128(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return d
}

func objectID(hex string) bson.ObjectID {
	id, err := bson.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return id
}
